description.en: The aircraft "Zaku II " prepared by team " Monster" for the finals has been commercialized in the RG series.

description.ja: 「ＲＧ 1/144 MS-06R-1A 黒い三連星専用ザクＩＩ」をベースに、機体形状やカラーリングを再現。
